criteria.requirement: Implement cssselect.cache.SelectorCache(capacity=128) with translate(css, *, mode="xml", xhtml=False, prefix=...), stats(), clear(reset_stats=False). Cache actual builtin XML/HTML translation by complete CSS and every supported mode/XHTML/prefix field; no arbitrary custom translator sharing without fingerprint. Enforce positive non-bool capacity, true access-order LRU, isolated instances, fresh stats and lock-protected consistent concurrent access. Count failures as misses but never cache them. Preserve native parse/translation exceptions, old uncached APIs, and explicit clear/stat-reset semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
